title: Sitemap URL Extractor output
description: Run summary written to the key-value store; one flat JSON record per sitemap URL in the default dataset.

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of URL records pushed to the default dataset.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when maxUrls stopped collection before all sitemaps were fully read.

sitemapsProcessed.title: Sitemaps processed
sitemapsProcessed.description: Sitemap files (including index children) successfully fetched and parsed.

failedSitemaps.title: Failed sitemaps
failedSitemaps.description: Sitemaps that could not be fetched or parsed, with the reason. Reported, never silent.
